race.comment: TEMPTATION (10) Lucky Vega filly from Wonderful Feeling on debut for the Baker yard. Has impressed in her two trial wins at Rosehill and Tommy Berry retains the ride from the inside gate. Hard to hold out. UNLEASH HARRY (1) handy gelding resuming. Failed to come up last prep when a battling seventh from the wide gate over 1100m at Warwick Farm last June. Closed strongly when third in his only trial over 745m at Randwick. Looks to be back on track and senior rider hops aboard from the low draw. IN CIRCLES (2) returns from a lengthy break. Ran second on debut at Hawkesbury, then jumped in trip when fourth over 1200m at Newcastle last March. Maps well and fitted with the two trials. Gets her chance. CAPDIVA (3) even return when fifth over 1000m at this course on July 23. Should keep improving as she gets out in trip.
